_comment: Case-file check on the live case: which data does the precise plant claim commit the investigation to collecting.

stem.en: Illustrative case. The claim is: "Among men who worked at the plant, at least 5 years of reactor cleaning causes this liver tumour, with more years giving more risk, appearing 10 or more years after first exposure." Which record must the investigation collect for each man?

text.en: Only whether he ever cleaned a reactor, recorded as a simple yes or no
The number of liver tumours diagnosed in the whole city in each year
His years of reactor cleaning, the year cleaning began, and his diagnosis date
His years of reactor cleaning, but not the year in which the cleaning began

explanation.en: "At least 5 years" and "more years, more risk" need the years of cleaning; "10 or more years after first exposure" needs the year cleaning began and the date of diagnosis. A yes/no record loses the dose, and years without a start date lose the time-response. City-wide counts describe the problem but say nothing about each man.

hints.en: Match each part of the claim to the record that would confirm it.
